info_3_desc: All features included at no cost. Create unlimited events with any number of participants.
page_faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about organizing your Secret Santa
faq_1_a: Secret Santa is a gift exchange where each participant is randomly assigned another participant to give a gift to. The assignments are kept secret until the gift exchange happens. Our platform automates this entire process, from creating the event to sending out anonymous assignments.
faq_2_a: Yes! Our Secret Santa platform is completely free to use. There are no hidden fees, no premium tiers, and no limits on the number of events or participants. We believe in making holiday gift exchanges accessible to everyone.
faq_3_q: How many participants do I need?
faq_3_a: You need a minimum of 3 participants to create a Secret Santa event. There's no maximum limit - whether you have 5 people or 500, our system can handle it!
faq_4_a: Currently, our system creates completely random assignments to maintain fairness. If you have specific requirements (like couples not getting each other), you can reach out to us for custom event setup assistance.
faq_5_q: What if someone doesn't receive their email?
faq_5_a: If a participant doesn't receive their assignment email, first check spam folders. As the organizer, you'll receive a management link where you can resend individual emails or view all assignments if needed.
faq_6_q: Can I change details after creating the event?
faq_6_a: Yes! You'll receive a management link via email that allows you to edit event details, add or remove participants, and resend assignment emails. Changes made before assignments are sent won't affect anything.
faq_7_q: Is my data secure and private?
faq_7_a: Absolutely. We take privacy seriously. Email addresses are only used to send assignment notifications and are not shared with third parties. Assignments are randomly generated and encrypted. We don't store sensitive information longer than necessary.
faq_8_q: Can I use this for other types of gift exchanges?
faq_8_a: Yes! While designed for Secret Santa, our platform works great for any gift exchange scenario - White Elephant, office parties, family gatherings, or friend groups. Any event where you need random, anonymous pairings.

privacy_section_1_desc: At Secret Santa, we take your privacy seriously. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our platform.
privacy_section_2_desc: When you create a Secret Santa event, we collect:
privacy_section_2_li_4: Basic technical information (IP address, browser type) for security purposes
privacy_section_3_desc: Your information is used exclusively to:
privacy_section_3_li_1: Send Secret Santa assignment emails to participants
privacy_section_3_li_2: Provide event management capabilities to organizers
privacy_section_3_li_3: Send reminder emails about upcoming events
privacy_section_3_li_4: Improve our service and prevent abuse
privacy_section_4_desc: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. All assignments are randomly generated and encrypted. We do not share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy_section_5_desc: Event data is retained for 90 days after the event date to allow for late management and resending emails. After this period, all personal information is automatically deleted from our servers.
privacy_section_6_li_1: Request deletion of your event and all associated data at any time
privacy_section_6_li_2: Access information we hold about you
privacy_section_7_desc: We use minimal cookies for essential functionality only. We do not use tracking cookies or analytics that identify individual users.
privacy_section_8_desc: We use trusted third-party email service providers to send notifications. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your data and use it only for sending emails on our behalf.
privacy_section_9_desc: Our service is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately.
privacy_section_10_desc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify users of any material changes via email to event organizers.
privacy_section_11_desc: If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your data rights, please contact us at privacy@secretsanta.example.com
